Maria (Docs): Heads-up — opened PR to update the ZetaX model card with supported seq lengths, embed throughput, and an SDK streaming snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4823 Please proofread and flag any runtime compatibility notes. cc @Ajay @Kelly
Ajay (ML): Quick Q: are the bench numbers p50/p95 measured at 512 or 1024 tokens? The PR table says 1k but the bench CSV looks like 512.
Kelly (Runtime): Also note: the quantized variant currently falls back to CPU for contexts >2k on most Dedicated pools. We should add an explicit limit under "limits" and suggest an alternative for long-context usage.
Maria (Docs): Good catch — I'll add a short callout. @Ajay if you can confirm the seq used I'll update the table and the snippet.
Ajay (ML): Ran a quick local run: zetaX-7B fp16 on A100, 512 tokens -> p50=42ms/token, p95=98ms/token. At 1024 tokens p95 ~1.8x. I'll push the raw numbers to the bench CSV in this PR shortly.
CI Bot: docs PR #4823 — mkdocs build failed: broken link to /docs/sdk/streaming.md referenced from model-cards/zetaX.md
Maria (Docs): On it — that link moved during the SDK reorg. I'll update to /sdk/clients/python/streaming.md and re-run the build.
Kelly (Runtime): Also include a minimal streaming snippet for SDK v2 call shape in the examples section. I can paste one if helpful.
Ajay (ML): One more compatibility note: TRT kernel support is only on the nv-next runtime. Call that out so Dedicated customers don't expect TRT speedups on generic pools.
Maria (Docs): I'll add a compatibility callout. Drafting edits now and will push a follow-up commit that fixes the link + bench CSV.
Kelly (Runtime): Snippet suggestion for examples block:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
for chunk in client.generate(model='zetaX-7b', prompt='...', stream=True):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Use that under "SDK examples" and note the streaming param shape.
Maria (Docs): Perfect — will include. Last items: editorial pass on tone and update bench table caption. @James for a quick review? :eyes:
James (EngDocs): Happy to review this afternoon. Tiny nits: change the table header 'throughput' -> 'tokens/s' and in prose prefer '95th percentile' instead of 'p95'.
Maria (Docs): Thanks — applying nits + resolved CI + bench CSV push. Targeting merge EOD. :sparkles:
